stories.short: Strictly fans call out a couple for not saying thank you
stories.headline: Strictly fans call out a couple for *not saying thank you*
stories.what: On Sunday's results show, viewers on social media called Cach Mercer and Maddie Ingoldsby “rude” for not thanking voters after being kept in. Cach later posted an Instagram video thanking his supporters.
stories.why: Audiences now judge the moments between the performance. A thank-you, a reply or a tone of voice is part of the content.

stories.short: The UK's Halloween costume of the year is Nikki from Obsession
stories.headline: The UK's costume of the year: *Nikki from Obsession*
stories.what: A BBC round-up on Saturday found fancy dress shops, influencers and make-up artists naming Nikki as the most copied look. One Bournemouth shop says Scream masks make up 20% of its sales, and KPop Demon Hunters leads for kids.
stories.why: Costume season is peaking now, and the Ramalama (Bang Bang) strut is back as the go-to reveal format.
stories.source: BBC via AOL UK, 17 Oct; New Engen, 14 Oct

stories.short: TikTok banned a documentary's ads, then called it an error
stories.headline: TikTok banned a documentary's ads, then *called it an error*
stories.what: TikTok gave the ad account for the film Musk a “permanent suspension” over political content, then restored it, saying it was “restored after an error”. Meta and YouTube had also rejected its ads before reversing.
stories.why: Ad approval for provocative titles is unpredictable. Entertainment launches need a back-up plan for paid.
stories.source: TechCrunch, 17–18 Oct (first reported by The Hollywood Reporter)

stories.short: LinkedIn brings back the business card
stories.headline: LinkedIn brings back the *business card*
stories.what: LinkedIn is rolling out a digital business card you can design, with your headshot, job title and a QR code, and keep in your phone's wallet. It goes global over the coming months.
stories.why: Events are where B2B relationships start. This makes LinkedIn the default handshake again.

stories.short: Instagram makes response Reels easier with “Use as reference”
stories.headline: Instagram's *“Use as reference”* makes response Reels easier
stories.what: Creators can now overlay another Reel (under 90 seconds) in the camera to match a response clip. It's iOS only for now. Instagram is also removing Reels series links on 28 Oct.
stories.why: Side-by-side recreations are about to get easier on Instagram, so expect more of them in feeds.

stories.short: TikTok Shop UK sellers can now post shoppable photo carousels
stories.headline: TikTok Shop UK adds *shoppable photo carousels*
stories.what: UK sellers can turn two or more product images into a swipeable post that links to products, with no video needed. Live shopping also gets group deals and price cuts once a sales target is hit.
stories.why: Brands without video can now sell straight from feed with product photos they already have.
stories.source: TikTok Shop UK via Social Media Today, 14 Oct
